utv.uk.description: Emma Willis and Tom Allen host as stars Joey Essex, Caroline Quentin and Harry Akines-Aryeetey try to impress with their British budget dishes in a 3-way cooking battle. They'll deliver classic British dishes on just £3 a portion all in a bid to secure a place in the semi final. The stars who fail to impress our world class chefs will head into the dreaded cook-off - where one more will leave the competition. - 2021

utv.uk.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure - Lossiemouth
utv.uk.description: James and his travelling companion Nick Nairn continue their Scottish adventure in Lossiemouth, which is home to the first RAF squadron and a fleet of Typhoon fighter jets - James fulfils a lifetime ambition of training in a Typhoon flight simulator before heading airside to cook up homemade crumpets with buttered lobster, spinach and samphire for the RAF staff. James next pays a visit to two ex-RAF Lossiemouth pilots who are living the dream and running their own craft brewery just down the road from their old base - he's so inspired that he takes some of their beer and uses it to make a classic comforting one-pot beef stew and dumplings. Back at Lossiemouth, Nick shows the base's young recruits some tasty recipe suggestions that they can make in their digs, and there's a surprise in store as James has arranged for him to be put through his paces at an RAF fitness test. Finally, James takes one of the area's most abundant fish and makes mackerel and cauliflower with mango dressing. (Documentary, Reality) - 2019

utv.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh - Sunday 15 Nov

bbc3.uk.title: Behind Bars: Sex, Bribes and Murder
bbc3.uk.description: After a three-minute video featuring a female prison officer and an inmate having sex inside HMP Wandsworth goes viral, award-winning journalist Mobeen Azhar begins an investigation into what happened and why. A year of twists, turns and damning revelations pulls back the curtain on a dangerous wider world of coercion, corruption and contraband thriving behind bars.

bbc3.uk.title: Behind Bars: Sex, Bribes and Murder
bbc3.uk.description: As Mobeen's investigation deepens, it becomes clearer that illicit relationships between prisoners and jail staff are just the tip of the iceberg. The bigger story involves organised criminal gangs determined to cash in on a lucrative prison drug economy. When news breaks of a prison governor being jailed for a relationship with a drug-dealing gang boss, Mobeen becomes determined to uncover the true extent of criminal influence inside our prisons.

bbconelondon.uk.title: Simply Nigella
bbconelondon.uk.description: The focus is on ensuring a cosy and comforting vibe. Breakfast is a tray of cheering Chai muffins - light, luscious and dairy free. For a low key lunch, there's Nigella's Asian-flavoured short ribs - a perfect make-ahead, meltingly tender beef stew. (Cookery, Entertainment) - 2015

bbconelondon.uk.description: In a Doctors special, two teams of actors from BBC One's daytime drama series battle it out at an antiques fair in Nottinghamshire. On the red team are Dex Lee, and Kia Pegg. Their opponents on the blue team are Sarah Moyle and Dido Miles. (Arts/crafts, Auction, Collectibles, Game show) - 2024

bbconelondon.uk.title: The Football Interview
bbconelondon.uk.description: The biggest names in sport and entertainment join host Kelly Somers for bold, in-depth conversations about the nation's favourite sport. (Interview, Football)

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Bargain Hunt
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S68 E23 Exeter 23 Caroline Hawley hosts the latest contest from Exeter, where antiques experts Ben Cooper and Kate Bliss help two teams of contestants pick out three items to sell at auction. Items considered include a Georgian-style silver serving dish and arts and crafts copper candlesticks. Caroline also heads to Box, near Bath, to visit the UK's only tennis ball manufacturer, where she learns about the origins of the tennis ball and how it gets its all-important bounce. Then everyone heads to auction, where Tim Weeks presides in Wiltshire.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Scam Interceptors
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S6 E12 Foal Play The ground team are dispatched to stop a woman from Woking paying out to a known cryptocurrency scam, but everything seems to be going against them, including the local roadworks. The team also join forces with an ethical hacker to investigate a man from Cameroon claiming to sell horses on social media.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Doorbell Detectives
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2 E4 Matt Allwright hears how Linda rushed over to her 87-year-old father's house after a group of rogue traders turned up saying he needed work doing. Plus, a man who chased down a gang of suspected car thieves.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Escape to the Country
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S26 E38 Devon Nicki Chapman helps a retired couple from Northamptonshire find their perfect coastal retreat in Devon. They're dreaming of a single-storey home close to the sea, and one of the properties delivers breathtaking ocean views right from the terrace. Nicki also meets a couple raising a family in a Dartmoor village, who share their love of the outdoors by mapping walks in the National Park for all ages and abilities to enjoy.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 Highlands - Treasure in the Attic Dominic Chinea is joined by an Inverness plastering expert to try to preserve art painted by Polish soldiers on the walls of the attic of Nairn Museum during the Second World War. Will Kirk is in Beauly to meet Alan MacPherson, who instructs him in the intricacies of creating shinty sticks to stand up to the rigours of this hard-fought game.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Finish Line
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E19 Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Lee, Has, Nina, Rob and Amanda race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Lee, Has, Nina, Rob and Amanda race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Vick Hope.

Jules also needs a keen eye to spot some of the world's rarest - and most camera-shy - species of deer and antelope at a local safari park.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 Yorkshire - Crumbling York Minster Gets Rescued York Minster is one of the UK's most magnificent cathedrals, boasting the world's largest expanse of medieval stained glass. However, the stonework of this glorious gothic monument is crumbling away on a daily basis. Dominic Chinea and Will Kirk join the new generation of stonemasons being trained to save it, harnessing modern technology while still using centuries-old skills.

Starting in Glasgow, Owain passes through Scotland, Northern Ireland and north-west England before finishing in central Cardiff and along the way he meets some inspirational children and their families whose lives have been transformed by projects funded by the charity.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Return to Paradise
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S3 E3 The Final Shot The anniversary screening of Dolphin Cove cult horror film Blood Wave goes off with a literal bang when one of its key creatives is killed during the iconic gunshot sequence, Mack and Glenn investigate how the killer fired a gun in front of a packed cinema without the audience realising.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Have I Got News for You
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S72 E7 Kelly Cates hosts, with comedian Maisie Adam and journalist Krishnan Guru-Murthy joining team captains Ian Hislop and Paul Merton as they delve into the news.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Bill's Included
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E1 The Landfriend When Bill's wife walks out on him for the gardener, he's left lonely and broke. In the hope of turning his life around, he lets out his spare rooms to four students. Bill is thrilled to meet his new housemates - Christian, Zahra, Hettie, and James - but when Christian keeps leaving the fridge door open, he has to come up with a scheme to get it shut without ruining his image as a relaxed, fun landlord. Comedy, starring Rob Brydon.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Fall

eden.uk.plus1.title: Mammals - Dark
eden.uk.plus1.description: Today, more than two-thirds of mammal species are nocturnal, and in this episode we will uncover the intriguing strategies they have evolved, from remarkable senses to teamwork, intelligence and adaptability, which have enabled them to overcome a time we find so challenging. Nocturnal mammals have developed an array of sharp senses. And, unlike us, many are blessed with incredible night vision. (Documentary, Nature) - 2024

eden.uk.plus1.title: Mammals - The New Wild
eden.uk.plus1.description: For millions of years, mammals have evolved to master every environment on Earth, but the planet is changing rapidly, all thanks to one mammal in particular - humans. As mankind reshapes the face of the world, mammals must change with it if they are to survive, let alone thrive. Today, some are finding clever and surprising ways to make the most of this new wild, while others need a helping hand from us. (Documentary, Nature) - 2024

eden.uk.plus1.title: Mammals - Water
eden.uk.plus1.description: We witness some of the most intimate and surprising behaviours of marine mammals. Raising the bar on our understanding of how whales and dolphins make their lives at sea, as well as meeting those terrestrial mammals that dip their toes, and sometimes more, into the watery world. (Documentary, Nature) - 2024

The last remaining duo have the opportunity to win the money they've banked earlier in the show to potentially double their winnings, or leaving with nothing. Adil Ray hosts.

stvnorth.uk.title: Deal or No Deal
stvnorth.uk.description: S3 E14 Jordan Stephen Mulhern hosts as Jordan tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a life-changing cash prize.

They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

stvnorth.uk.title: I'm a Celebrity Get Me Out of Here!
stvnorth.uk.description: S26 E4 Ant and Dec cover the action, and present highlights from the past 24 hours in camp, while the dreaded Bushtucker Trials decide whether campers eat or go hungry. Content creator Sharky and TV presenter AJ Odudu are among those hoping they have what it takes to win the contest.

stvnorth.uk.title: Scam Britain: Are You at Risk? - Tonight
stvnorth.uk.description: S28 E20 With scams costing the UK public billions of pounds last year, they continue to pose a significant threat to many. With two thirds of people saying they live in fear of becoming a victim, what type of scams are being used, and how can viewers protect themselves? Paul Brand reports.

stvnorth.uk.title: Abbey Clancy: Celebrity Homes
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E4 Sheree Murphy and Caprice Actress and presenter Sheree Murphy shows Abbey how she's adapted her Cheshire mansion for her growing family, including a cinema room, boujee bar and her own dressing room. Model and entrepreneur Caprice reveals how she created a family home in London.

stvnorth.uk.title: Abbey Clancy: Celebrity Homes
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E2 Olivia Bowen and Emma Thynn Abbey hangs out with Love Islander and fashion blogger Olivia Bowen in the Essex mansion she always dreamt of living in as a child. She is also invited to Longleat House for a peek inside the private apartments of Emma Thynn, the Marchioness of Bath.

stvnorth.uk.title: Murder at the Grand Canal: True Crime Presents
stvnorth.uk.description: S2 E5 Documentary exploring the death of 23-year-old Marta Ligman, whose body was found in a suitcase floating in the Grand Union Canal in Little Venice in north-west London.

stvnorth.uk.title: Scotland Revealed Moments

stvnorth.uk.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
stvnorth.uk.description: S37 E9 Ep 9 (Ep 5 - Part 1) Compilation of TV clangers, gaffes and fluffed cues featuring Kylie Minogue, Michael McIntyre, King Charles III, Romesh Ranganathan, Sue Perkins, Roman Kemp and more. Plus, the moment Mary Berry almost burns down Alan Carr's house. Tom Allen hosts.

stvnorth.uk.description: E10700 20/11/2026 Caleb panics as he realises someone saw his kiss with Sadie, while Nicola and Lewis try to resolve their work disputes and April and Dylan's relationship faces further strain.

stvnorth.uk.title: Coronation Street
stvnorth.uk.description: E11985 20/11/2026 Lily, Jake, Hope and Ruby set off fireworks in the street, Ross advises Tyrone to show Fiz who's boss, and Brody feels guilty as the factory workers face a frugal Christmas.

stvnorth.uk.title: I'm a Celebrity Get Me Out of Here!
stvnorth.uk.description: S26 E5 As contestants including comedian Jack Skipper and model Leomie Anderson near the end of their first week in camp, Ant and Dec present highlights from the past 24 hours in the jungle. Which of them has what it takes to clinch victory in December's final.

stvnorth.uk.title: How to Clean Up for Cash
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E1 Josie Gibson presents as families have a loved one's clutter cleared and valued in secret by antiques expert Dan Hatfield and declutterer Jacqueline McLeod. The first mission is in Somerset, where they help Mel, who is desperate for her husband of three years Paul to rent out his house and move in with her so his clutter has to go. However, this is no easy task as Paul is a private investigator.

stvnorth.uk.title: How to Clean Up for Cash
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E2 Josie Gibson and the team head to north-east England to help Ashley clear out and value the clutter of her mum Mandy, who has been lured out of the house and is unaware of what is happening. From a Victorian commode to a bust of Elvis, Josie falls in love with Mandy's eclectic taste, but Ashley is determined to see it gone for good.

stvnorth.uk.title: Unwind with STV
stvnorth.uk.description: Daily escape designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection.

stvnorth.uk.description: S3 E15 Jade Stephen Mulhern hosts as Jade tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a life-changing cash prize.

stvnorth.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars
stvnorth.uk.description: S6 E7 Emma Willis and Tom Allen host as Joey Essex, Caroline Quentin and Harry Aikines-Aryeetey try to impress with their British budget dishes in a three-way cooking battle. They'll deliver classic British dishes on just £3 a portion all in a bid to secure a place in the semi-final. The stars who fail to impress our world-class chefs will head into the dreaded cook-off - where one more will leave the competition.

stvnorth.uk.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E2 Lossiemouth James Martin and his travelling companion Nick Nairn continue their Scottish adventure in Lossiemouth, home to the first RAF squadron and a fleet of typhoon fighter jets. James fulfils a childhood dream and Nick takes part in a fitness test.

stvnorth.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
stvnorth.uk.description: S8 E30 Joining Alan at Manor Farm are Chris McCausland, Sort Your Life Out's Dilly Carter and actress Rachael Stirling. Plus, the second instalment of the Wildlife Sanctuary in the making, Urban Birder David Lindo gets up close with pelicans, and Ian Burrell has a good measure of rum hot toddies.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News
stvnorth.uk.description: E89 21/11/2026 A round-up of the latest headlines.

stvnorth.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
stvnorth.uk.description: S9 E36 In a rugby-themed show, James cooks for former England player Maggie Alphonsi and ITV Sport's chief presenter Mark Pougatch. Chef Doug Crampton and baker Richard Bertinet are also in the kitchen and gardening expert David Domeney talks growing and nurturing apples.

stvnorth.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E5 Quick and Fabulous Suppers Clodagh McKenna demonstrates four of her favourite recipes for quick and fabulous suppers, including a chicken curry, and creamy Gruyère baked eggs. She then takes an emotional trip down memory lane to share a speedy pancetta and garlic mussels dish inspired by her dad, before whipping up a pan of cheesy lemony ate-night Alfredo pasta.

talkingpictures.uk.title: So Long at the Fair (1950)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Two siblings visit Paris for the Great Exhibition of 1889 when one of them go missing. (Mystery) - 1950

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Duchess of Duke Street - One Night's Grace
talkingpictures.uk.description: John Hawkesworth, having created 'Upstairs, Downstairs', went on to create this period drama. Louisa is curious when a young lady asks for Lord Haslemere. (Historical drama, Romance) - 1976

talkingpictures.uk.title: The End of the Affair (1955)
talkingpictures.uk.description: As war rages over London, neighbours Maurice Bendrix and Sarah Miles fall in love and begin a relationship. Unfortunately Sarah is married to Henry, a work colleague of the American Maurice, who confides in him that he thinks his wife is cheating on him. (Drama) - 1955

talkingpictures.uk.title: Whispering Smith Hits London (1952)
talkingpictures.uk.description: US sleuth Whispering Smith arrives in London on holiday, is soon called in to solve the case of a suicide which the father thinks was murder. (Mystery) - 1952

talkingpictures.uk.title: Weir's Way - An Edinburgh Volcano
talkingpictures.uk.description: Tom Weir visits Arthur's Seat in Edinburgh, the most studied volcano in the world and where the very beginnings of geology were laid by Edinburgh geologist James Hutton. (Entertainment, Travel) - 1981

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Brothers - The Guilt Beneath the Gingerbread
talkingpictures.uk.description: Brian finds himself alone to answer police questioning. Meanwhile, unrest at the depot continues. (Drama) - 2024

talkingpictures.uk.title: Saber of London - Man About To Die
talkingpictures.uk.description: The hero of a children's sci-fi programme on television is a man without enemies, or so he thinks until someone threatens his life. (Drama, Crime) - 1958

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
talkingpictures.uk.description: Julie Rogers performs 'My World Gets Smaller Every Day', and Wild Honey perform 'I Can't Leave You Alone'. Plus, Dustin Gee, Ronnie Dukes and Ricki Lee star. (Comedy, Music) - 1975

talkingpictures.uk.title: Lord Jim (1965)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Powerful tale of cowardice and redemption, based on Joseph Conrad's classic novel. During a hurricane, a seaman abandons his ship and its passengers to save himself. Many die horribly, and the sailor knows that he will always be branded a coward. Much later, when he takes on a job transporting dynamite upriver to a tribe rebelling against oppression, he hopes that the perilous task will lead to spiritual regeneration. (Adventure / Drama / Romance) - 1965

talkingpictures.uk.title: Up the Chastity Belt (1971)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A medieval knight who looks like Richard the Lionheart joins the Crusades with his slow-witted serf. (Comedy) - 1971

talkingpictures.uk.title: A Home of Your Own (1965)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A wordless, satirical look at British builders as they attempt to build a young couple's dream home. (Comedy) - 1965

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sergeant Cork - The Case of the Knotted Scarf
talkingpictures.uk.description: A woman is found dead, strangled with a knotted scarf. Leaving behind a husband some 26 years her senior. (Drama, Crime) - 1963

talkingpictures.uk.title: Burke's Law - Who Killed Rosie Sunset
talkingpictures.uk.description: Elderly woman who sold maps of stars' homes is slain. (Drama, Suspense) - 1965

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - Green Ice
talkingpictures.uk.description: Mr Freeze returns to continue his plans for revenge against Batman and Robin for condemning him to live in subzero temperatures, and thus terrorise Gotham City. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Crime) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - Deep Freeze
talkingpictures.uk.description: The dynamic duo locate the heat exhaust valve and turn it on, so that recycled exhaust in the heating unit will reverse the refrigerating process and manage to melt their way out through the resulting heat. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Crime) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Secret Man (1958)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A physicist finds himself drawn into an investigation to track down a spy at his research station. (Drama / Thriller) - 1958

talkingpictures.uk.title: Life in Emergency Ward 10 (1957)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Surgeons battle to save the life of a boy with a failing heart in this film version of a popular British TV series. (Drama) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: Railway Murders - The Guardsman
talkingpictures.uk.description: The story of Jimmy Alcott, a troubled young man who, in 1952, staked out a railway station and plotted a theft that would end in murder.

talkingpictures.uk.title: There Was A Young Lady (1953)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A diamond merchants' secretary gets fired by her new boss for being too efficient. (Comedy) - 1953

talkingpictures.uk.title: The History of Mr Polly (1949)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Mr Polly, disillusioned by the constant nagging of his wife and his dull life, torches his shop and takes to the open road. He ends up in the heart of the countryside where after a few hitches, he begins a new life with a jovial innkeeper. (Adventure) - 1949

talkingpictures.uk.title: Camera Magic
talkingpictures.uk.description: An insight behind the scenes of the `magic making' of films and many `tricks of the trade'. (Documentary, Special) - 1947

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood - The Thorkill Ghost
talkingpictures.uk.description: Robin (Richard Greene) and his men come to the aid of a young lame heir (Ian Whittaker) who fears a ghost is trying to kill him. With Barbara Mullen, Charles Stapley. (Action, Adventure) - 1956

talkingpictures.uk.title: Carrie's War (2004)
talkingpictures.uk.description: During World War II a British teen and her brother must relocate to a Welsh mining town. (Drama) - 2004

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Cheaters - Knight of the Road
talkingpictures.uk.description: Eastern Insurance pay £6,000 to Ken Northwood when his car is stolen but three other insurers have also paid out.. (Drama, Mystery) - 1962

talkingpictures.uk.title: A Family At War - Clash by Night
talkingpictures.uk.description: A blinded Phillip encounters an old enemy who once shot one of his comrades in the Spanish Civil. (Drama, War) - 1971

talkingpictures.uk.title: Appointment in London (1953)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A brash British pilot insists on flying a dangerous mission to Germany despite the orders of his superiors, finding solace in his friendship with a war widow. (War) - 1953

talkingpictures.uk.title: Public Eye - How About It, Frank
talkingpictures.uk.description: Ron Gash wants Marker as his new partner. But are Gash's methods compatible with Marker's. (Drama, Mystery, Crime) - 1975

talkingpictures.uk.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro - Intro - Shatter
talkingpictures.uk.description: Caroline Munro is down in The Cellar Club ready to whisk you away to Hong Kong with the 1974 film Shatter, a co-production by Hammer Films and Shaw Brothers Studio. (Horror, Science fiction) - 2026

talkingpictures.uk.title: Shatter (1976)
talkingpictures.uk.description: An international hit man is targeted by villains when he arrives in Hong Kong to pick up a payoff, having completed a political assassination in Africa. (Action / Adventure) - 1976

talkingpictures.uk.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro - Outro Week 174
talkingpictures.uk.description: Caroline Munro asks you to don your rain macs and camel-hair coats next week, to travel once again outside the confines of the Cellar Club for a very special live event. (Horror, Science fiction) - 2026

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Last Vampyre (1993)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A village vicar alerts Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson to a newcomer who frequents the local graveyard. (Mystery) - 1993

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Big Trees (1952)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Jim Fallon, an unscrupulous lumber baron goes to northern California to part the Quaker settlers from their giant sequoias. However, the homesteaders are having none of it, and Fallon ends up falling for one of the Friends. (Western) - 1952

talkingpictures.uk.title: Fort Algiers (1952)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A spirited young French woman attempts to unmask a self-appointed leader of Arab rebels in Algiers, for her Foreign Legion lover. (Adventure) - 1952

talkingpictures.uk.title: About Bread
talkingpictures.uk.description: A short reel about the process of making bread from importing ingredients, to baking and distributing. Plus, the nutritional benefits for everyone that bread can provide.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Vise - Account Closed
talkingpictures.uk.description: Harry Brandon gambles and fails on get rich quick schemes, until his wife is accused of theft and there is a finding fee. (Drama, Crime) - 2026

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - The Impractical Joker
talkingpictures.uk.description: The caped crusader and the boy wonder head to Angus Ferguson's rare key exhibition. There, The Joker steals the jewelled key of Kaincardine with the aid of his new invention, a mysterious little spark-spewing box that leaves the dynamic duo completely helpless while he escapes with the key. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Crime) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - The Joker's Provokers
talkingpictures.uk.description: Batman quickly Batpummels The Joker's minions, rescues a now wax-immobilised Robin from the wax spray machine, returns him to the Batcave, and restores him to normal with the aid of Batwax-solvent. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Crime) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Bombay Waterfront (1952)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A serial killer terrorises London. Each victim is found with a telegram signed '`The Marquis'. There seems to be no other common thread between the victims. An amateur sleuth who is warned to stay away from the case starts to investigate. (Mystery / Thriller) - 1952

talkingpictures.uk.title: Serena (1962)
talkingpictures.uk.description: An inspector strives to solve the mystery of an artist's dead wife. The artist becomes the main suspect. (Mystery / Thriller) - 1962

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Adventures of William Tell - Manhunt
talkingpictures.uk.description: Trapped on an island owned by Prince Erik, a man who enjoys hunting prey, Tell's career appears to be at the end. (Adventure, Archery) - 1959

talkingpictures.uk.title: Object Z - The Meteor
talkingpictures.uk.description: A mysterious object is sighted heading towards Earth and causes panic. But what is the nature and origin of the object, and how can it be stopped. (Drama, Science fiction) - 1965

talkingpictures.uk.title: William at the Circus
talkingpictures.uk.description: William Brown begins to devise a plan to secure more pay and shorter hours for schoolboys.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Venture Adventure
talkingpictures.uk.description: A short film encouraging young men to enlist in the Army Training Corps, which was set up to train men in aviation skills, navigation and general duties for entry into the RAF. (Documentary, Special) - 2026

talkingpictures.uk.title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans - False Faces
talkingpictures.uk.description: A series of thefts are falsely attributed to the innocent Mingo False Faces. (Action, Adventure, Western) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Lone Ranger - Pete and Pedro
talkingpictures.uk.description: A ruthless man plans to gain control over a young woman's property. (Adventure, Western) - 1949

talkingpictures.uk.title: Supercar - The Lost City
talkingpictures.uk.description: On the way to the South Pole, an uncontrolled force lands them on a strange island where they are in danger. (Fantasy, Science fiction, Children) - 1961

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood - Highland Fling
talkingpictures.uk.description: King Richard decides to send Robin and Tuck on a mission to Scotland to collect a debt in the form of gold. (Action, Adventure) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: Target Earth (1955)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A large city is ordered to be completely evacuated as an army of robots, believed to be from the planet Venus, attack it. (Science fiction) - 1955

amc.us.title: Judge Dredd
amc.us.description: In the crime-plagued future, the only thing standing between order and chaos is Judge Joseph Dredd (Sylvester Stallone). His duty: police the violent metropolitan sprawls that crowd the decaying earth, and kill criminals on the spot if necessary. The tables are turned, however, when maniacal ex-Judge Rico (Armand Assante) frames Dredd for murder. But, as his opponents soon discover, not even a prison sentence can stop Dredd from doling out his signature brand of justice. (Action, Science fiction) - 1995

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 -- Parabellum
amc.us.description: After gunning down a member of the High Table -- the shadowy international assassin's guild -- legendary hit man John Wick finds himself stripped of the organization's protective services. Now stuck with a $14 million bounty on his head, Wick must fight his way through the streets of New York as he becomes the target of the world's most ruthless killers. (Action, Thriller, Adventure, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2019

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
amc.us.description: With the price on his head ever-increasing, legendary hit man John Wick takes his fight against the High Table global as he seeks out the most powerful players in the underworld, from New York to Paris to Japan to Berlin. (Action) - 2023

amc.us.title: The Shawshank Redemption
amc.us.description: Andy Dufresne (Tim Robbins) is sentenced to two consecutive life terms in prison for the murders of his wife and her lover and is sentenced to a tough prison. However, only Andy knows he didn't commit the crimes. While there, he forms a friendship with Red (Morgan Freeman), experiences brutality of prison life, adapts, helps the warden, etc., all in 19 years. (Drama) - 1994

amc.us.title: TNA iMPACT! ᴸᶦᵛᵉ

amc.us.title: Gran Torino
amc.us.description: Retired autoworker and Korean War vet Walt Kowalski fills emptiness in his life with beer and home repair, despising the many Asian, Latino and black families in his neighborhood. Walt becomes a reluctant hero when he stands up to the gangbangers who tried to force an Asian teen to steal Walt's treasured car. An unlikely friendship develops between Walt and the teen, as he learns he has more in common with his neighbors than he thought. (Drama) - 2008

amc.us.title: A Bronx Tale
amc.us.description: As he grows into a teenager on the streets of the Bronx in the socially turbulent 1960s, Calogero gets taken under the wing of neighborhood mobster Sonny. Sonny initiates the boy into the ways of gangland life, in direct conflict with his straight-arrow bus driver father. But when Calogero falls for his African-American classmate, Jane, the repercussions threaten the entire neighborhood. (Crime drama) - 1993

amc.us.title: The Perfect Storm
amc.us.description: Based on a true story, the film tells of the courageous men and women who risk their lives every working day, pitting their fishing boats and rescue vessels against the capricious forces of nature. Their worst fears are realized at sea on Halloween of 1991, when they are confronted by three raging weather fronts which unexpectedly collide to produce the greatest, fiercest storm in modern history -- "The Perfect Storm." (Thriller, Drama, Adventure, Action) - 2000

amc.us.title: Jurassic World Dominion
amc.us.description: Four years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, dinosaurs now live and hunt alongside humans all over the world. This fragile balance will reshape the future and determine, once and for all, whether human beings are to remain the apex predators on a planet they now share with history's most fearsome creatures. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2022

amc.us.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
amc.us.description: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever. (Adventure, Action, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2017

amc.us.title: Men in Black
amc.us.description: Working for a highly funded yet unofficial government agency, Kay and Jay are the Men in Black, providers of immigration services and regulators of all things alien on Earth. While investigating a series of unregistered close encounters, the MIB agents uncover the deadly plot of an intergalactic terrorist who is on a mission to assassinate two ambassadors from opposing galaxies currently in residence in New York City. (Action, Comedy, Science fiction, Adventure, Mystery) - 1997

amc.us.title: Men in Black II
amc.us.description: Kay and Jay reunite to provide our best line of defense against a seductress who levels the toughest challenge yet to the MIB's mission statement: protecting the earth from the scum of the universe. While investigating a routine crime, Jay uncovers a plot masterminded by Serleena, a Kylothian monster who disguises herself as a lingerie model. When Serleena takes the MIB building hostage, there is only one person Jay can turn to -- his former MIB partner. (Action, Comedy, Science fiction) - 2002

cinemax.us.title: Judy
cinemax.us.description: Thirty years after starring in "The Wizard of Oz," beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform sold-out shows at the Talk of the Town nightclub. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Jazz) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: My Blind Brother
cinemax.us.description: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

cinemax.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemax.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (Horror, Thriller) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

cinemax.us.title: Extraction
cinemax.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. (Thriller, Action) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

cinemax.us.title: The East
cinemax.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Grudge Match
cinemax.us.description: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all. (Comedy) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Wedding Crashers
cinemax.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Super Troopers 2
cinemax.us.description: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Happy Death Day
cinemax.us.description: Tree Gelbman is a blissfully self-centered collegian who wakes up on her birthday in the bed of a student named Carter. As the morning goes on, Tree gets the eerie feeling that she's experienced the events of this day before. When a masked killer suddenly takes her life in a brutal attack, she once again magically wakes up in Carter's dorm room unharmed. Now, the frightened young woman must relive the same day over and over until she figures out who murdered her. (Horror, Thriller, Comedy, Mystery) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Scream
cinemax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
cinemax.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

cinemax.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemax.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Country, Rock) - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Open Water
cinemax.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama, Horror) - 2003

cinemax.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
cinemax.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: The Watchers
cinemax.us.description: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night. (Horror, Thriller) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
cinemax.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. (Action, Thriller) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: The Predator
cinemax.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Spring Breakers
cinemax.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Catfish
cinemax.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person. (Documentary, Drama, Mystery) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Shot Caller
cinemax.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Hoot
cinemax.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1972-03-12

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Hedorah
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla fights pollution in the form of living sludge found by a scientist (Akira Yamauchi) and his son (Toshie Kimura). (Action, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1971-07-24

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1973-03-17

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemaxaction.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1995-08-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Mom and Dad Save the World
cinemaxaction.us.description: While planning to destroy Earth with a gigantic laser beam, Emperor Tod Spengo (Jon Lovitz), ruler of the planet Spengo, catches a glimpse of housewife Marge Nelson (Teri Garr) and becomes smitten with her. Beaming Marge and her husband, Dick (Jeffrey Jones), up to Spengo from California, the daft, dimwitted leader tries to woo her, and sends her spouse to prison. Soon Dick is plotting an insurgency, in hopes of overthrowing Spengo and rescuing his wife. (Action, Adventure, Children, Comedy, Family) - 1992

cinemaxaction.us.title: Game Night
cinemaxaction.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie, Mystery) - 2018-02-23

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
cinemaxaction.us.description: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways. Soon, the full scope of Martin's intent becomes menacingly clear when he confronts Steven with a long-forgotten transgression that will shatter his domestic bliss forever. (Drama, Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2017-05-22

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Apparition
cinemaxaction.us.description: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2012-08-24

cinemaxaction.us.title: Enter Nowhere
cinemaxaction.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Movie, Mystery, Science Fiction) - 2011-10-22

cinemaxaction.us.title: Us
cinemaxaction.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2019-03-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Companion
cinemaxaction.us.description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire. (Dark comedy, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2025-01-10

cinemaxaction.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
cinemaxaction.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Action, Adventure, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2023-06-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Megan Leavey
cinemaxaction.us.description: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy. (Biography, Drama, Movie, War) - 2017-06-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
cinemaxaction.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2014-02-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Hangover Part II
cinemaxaction.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, prewedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy, Movie) - 2011-05-26

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ghidorah, the Three-Headed Monster
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla, Rodan and Mothra team up to save mankind from the deadliest threat of all -- a fire-breathing space monster. (Action, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1964-12-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman
cinemaxaction.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself "The Joker" (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Crime, Fantasy, Movie) - 1989-06-23

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemaxaction.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 1992-06-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemaxaction.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Crime, Fantasy, Movie) - 1995-06-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman & Robin
cinemaxaction.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 1997-06-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: Joker
cinemaxaction.us.description: Forever alone in a crowd, failed comedian Arthur Fleck seeks connection as he walks the streets of Gotham City. Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker. cinemaxhits.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive. (Adventure, Drama, Movie) - 2018-05-10

cinemaxwest.us.title: Aniara
cinemaxwest.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (Science fiction, Drama) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: Judy
cinemaxwest.us.description: Thirty years after starring in "The Wizard of Oz," beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform sold-out shows at the Talk of the Town nightclub. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Jazz) - 2019

cinemaxwest.us.title: My Blind Brother
cinemaxwest.us.description: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemaxwest.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

cinemaxwest.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemaxwest.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (Horror, Thriller) - 2016

cinemaxwest.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemaxwest.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

cinemaxwest.us.title: Extraction
cinemaxwest.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. (Thriller, Action) - 2015

cinemaxwest.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemaxwest.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

cinemaxwest.us.title: The East
cinemaxwest.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama) - 2013

cinemaxwest.us.title: Grudge Match
cinemaxwest.us.description: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all. (Comedy) - 2013

cinemaxwest.us.title: Wedding Crashers
cinemaxwest.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

cinemaxwest.us.title: Super Troopers 2
cinemaxwest.us.description: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: Happy Death Day
cinemaxwest.us.description: Tree Gelbman is a blissfully self-centered collegian who wakes up on her birthday in the bed of a student named Carter. As the morning goes on, Tree gets the eerie feeling that she's experienced the events of this day before. When a masked killer suddenly takes her life in a brutal attack, she once again magically wakes up in Carter's dorm room unharmed. Now, the frightened young woman must relive the same day over and over until she figures out who murdered her. (Horror, Thriller, Comedy, Mystery) - 2017

cinemaxwest.us.title: Scream
cinemaxwest.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

cinemaxwest.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
cinemaxwest.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemaxwest.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemaxwest.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemaxwest.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxwest.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

cinemaxwest.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemaxwest.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Country, Rock) - 2005

cinemaxwest.us.title: Open Water
cinemaxwest.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama, Horror) - 2003

cinemaxwest.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
cinemaxwest.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 2023

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Watchers
cinemaxwest.us.description: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night. (Horror, Thriller) - 2024

cinemaxwest.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
cinemaxwest.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. (Action, Thriller) - 2013

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Predator
cinemaxwest.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: Spring Breakers
cinemaxwest.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

cinemaxwest.us.title: Catfish
cinemaxwest.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person. (Documentary, Drama, Mystery) - 2010

cinemaxwest.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2017

freeform.us.title: Ice Age
freeform.us.description: Twenty-thousand years ago, Earth was a wondrous, prehistoric world filled with great danger, not the least of which is the beginning of the Ice Age. To avoid a terrible frostbite, the planet's majestic creatures - and a few small, slothful ones - begin migrating south. The story revolves around sub-zero heroes: a woolly mammoth, a saber-toothed tiger, a sloth and a prehistoric combination of a squirrel and rat, known as Scrat. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2002

freeform.us.title: Ice Age: The Meltdown
freeform.us.description: With global warming threatening their once-icy domain with widespread flooding, Manny (Ray Romano), Sid (John Leguizamo) and Diego (Denis Leary) set out to find a safe haven. Along the way, another mammoth (Queen Latifah), who thinks she is an opossum, joins the travelers on their perilous quest. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

freeform.us.title: Finding Nemo
freeform.us.description: Marlin (Albert Brooks), a clown fish, is overly cautious with his son, Nemo (Alexander Gould), who has a foreshortened fin. When Nemo swims too close to the surface to prove himself, he is caught by a diver, and horrified Marlin must set out to find him. A blue reef fish named Dory (Ellen DeGeneres) -- who has a really short memory -- joins Marlin and complicates the encounters with sharks, jellyfish, and a host of ocean dangers. Meanwhile, Nemo plots his escape from a dentist's fish tank. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2003

freeform.us.title: Finding Dory
freeform.us.description: Dory (Ellen DeGeneres) is a wide-eyed, blue tang fish who suffers from memory loss every 10 seconds or so. The one thing she can remember is that she somehow became separated from her parents as a child. With help from her friends Nemo and Marlin, Dory embarks on an epic adventure to find them. Her journey brings her to the Marine Life Institute, a conservatory that houses diverse ocean species. Dory now knows that her family reunion will only happen if she can save mom and dad from captivity. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2016

freeform.us.title: Chicken Little
freeform.us.description: Young Chicken Little (Zach Braff) throws his small town into panic by claiming the sky is falling. Unable to find the piece of "sky" that hit him, he earns the town's scorn. A year later, outcast Little tries to redeem himself by joining the baseball team, helping to win a crucial game. Later that night he is hit on the head again and discovers that the "falling sky" is actually from a UFO. Now, Little must convince the skeptical town that an alien invasion is about to happen. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2005

freeform.us.title: Dr. Seuss' The Grinch
freeform.us.description: The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbors in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realizes there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 2018

freeform.us.title: The Santa Clause
freeform.us.description: Divorced dad Scott (Tim Allen) has custody of his son (Eric Lloyd) on Christmas Eve. After he accidentally kills a man in a Santa suit, they are magically transported to the North Pole, where an elf explains that Scott must take Santa's place before the next Christmas arrives. Scott thinks he's dreaming, but over the next several months he gains weight and grows an inexplicably white beard. Maybe that night at the North Pole wasn't a dream after all -- and maybe Scott has a lot of work to do. (Family, Holiday, Comedy) - 1994

freeform.us.title: The Santa Clause 2

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

gameshowcentral.us.title: Baggage
gameshowcentral.us.description: Contestants on this dating game show don't want to hear the elimination line "I'm sorry, but you have too much baggage." How much is acceptable among three contestants in each episode is determined by the "dater," who hears the candidates' intimate secrets and hidden flaws, as well as their attempts to deflect these traits by describing their positive attributes. After two elimination rounds leave one remaining contestant, it's the dater's turn to reveal his or her own baggage ... and then the contestant decides to go forward with the date or not. Jerry Springer hosts. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20100419

At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything.
