moremax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
moremax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

moremax.us.title: The Flash
moremax.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2023

moremax.us.title: Mickey 17
moremax.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Science fiction, Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Opus
moremax.us.description: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan. (Thriller, Horror, Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Due Date
moremax.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. (Dark comedy, Comedy drama) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Internship
moremax.us.description: After old-school salesmen Billy and Nick find themselves downsized, Billy decides that, despite their complete lack of technological savvy, they should work for Google. The friends somehow manage to finagle internships at the Internet giant and promptly head out to Silicon Valley. Viewed with disdain by most of their fellow interns, Billy and Nick join forces with the rest of the misfit "nooglers" to make it through a series of competitive team challenges. (Comedy) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
moremax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Joker
moremax.us.description: Forever alone in a crowd, failed comedian Arthur Fleck seeks connection as he walks the streets of Gotham City. Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker. (Crime drama) - 2019

moremax.us.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
moremax.us.description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him. (Musical, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2024

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
moremax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
moremax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
moremax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

moremax.us.title: Lord of the Flies
moremax.us.description: Amidst a nuclear war, a plane carrying a group of schoolboys crash lands on a deserted island. With no adult survivors, the boys are forced to fend for themselves. At first, they cooperate, but when they split into two separate camps -- one led by the pragmatic Ralph (James Aubrey) and the other by militaristic Jack (Tom Chapin) -- their society falls into disarray, leading to a disturbing examination of human nature and a chilling conclusion. (Drama, Adventure, Thriller) - 1963

moremax.us.title: The Darkest Minds
moremax.us.description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Enter Nowhere
moremax.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Rampage
moremax.us.description: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, an extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla that's been in his care since birth. When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Shazam!
moremax.us.description: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2019

moremax.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
moremax.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

moremax.us.title: Time Bandits
moremax.us.description: Young history buff Kevin (Craig Warnock) can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being (Ralph Richardson), they've purloined a map charting all the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon (Ian Holm), Robin Hood (John Cleese) and King Agamemnon (Sean Connery) before the Supreme Being catches up with them. (Fantasy) - 1981

moremax.us.title: Hidden Figures
moremax.us.description: Three brilliant African American women at NASA, Katherine Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson, serve as the brains behind one of the greatest operations in history, the launch of astronaut John Glenn into orbit, a stunning achievement that restored the nation's confidence, turned around the Space Race and galvanized the world. (Historical drama, Docudrama, Biography) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Robin Hood
moremax.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Judge
moremax.us.description: Hank Palmer (Robert Downey Jr.), a brilliant but shady attorney, returns to his Indiana hometown after learning that his mother has passed away. His arrival triggers renewed tension between himself and his father, Judge Joseph Palmer (Robert Duvall), who makes no secret of his disapproval of Hank's morally ambiguous career. As the lawyer prepares to depart, his father is arrested for a hit-and-run death. Hank takes on his father's defense, despite the objections of the resentful old man. (Drama) - 2014

moremax.us.title: Trap
moremax.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Thriller) - 2024

moremax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
moremax.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Barry Lyndon
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Redmond Barry is a rogue Irishman who becomes the pupil of a conman, and is admitted to the highest social circles in Europe. Directed by Stanley Kubrik and starring Ryan O'Neal. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Down With Love
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In 1962 New York City, love blossoms between a playboy journalist and a feminist advice author. (Similar)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: La Chimera
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A young British archaeologist gets caught up in an international network dealing in stolen Italian artefacts. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Way Ahead
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: World War II drama that follows a group of British draftees, starting with their rigorous basic training, and ending with their deployment in North Africa. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Time Bandits
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Six fractious dwarfs steal a precious map that shows the locations of a series of time holes scattered across the universe, enabling them to travel back in time. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Stay
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A thriller about a psychologist whose client makes bizarre predictions that--to the psychologist's mounting terror-- begin to come true. He must race against time to save everything he loves. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Turn Me On
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In a world where the inconvenience of human emotion has been eradicated by a single daily vitamin, one young couple skips their dose and discovers love, joy, sex and the baggage that comes with it. (Comedy)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Snows of Kilimanjaro
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Writer Harry Street reflects on his life as he lies dying from an infection while on safari in the shadow of Mount Kilamanjaro. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Mary Shelley
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: She will forever be remembered as the writer who gave the world Frankenstein. But the real life story of Mary Shelley - and the creation of her immortal monster - is as fantastical as her prose. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Living
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: This is the story of an ordinary man, reduced by years of oppressive office routine to a shadow existence, who at the eleventh hour makes a supreme effort to turn his dull life into something wonderful. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Braveheart
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Romance, intrigue, heroism and the desperate battle for nothing less than the freedom of Scotland. The story of William Wallace whose passion and courage united the Scottish people in the struggle. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Resistance
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Before becoming the world-famous mime Marcel Marceau, aspiring Jewish actor Marcel Mangel (Jesse Eisenberg) joins the French Resistance to save thousands of orphaned children from the Nazis. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Recon
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: As WWII ends, four American soldiers are sent on a reconnaissance mission led by a partisan with indeterminate loyalties. Hunted by a mysterious sniper, they must fight to make it out alive. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Spear
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Seeing the problems faced by Aboriginal men in remote and urban communities, a young Aboriginal man sets off on a journey of initiation to understand what it means to be a man in a modern-day world. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Dancing At Lughnasa
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A young boy tells the story of growing up in a fatherless home with his unmarried mother and four spinster aunts in 1930s Ireland. (Meryl Streep, Catherine McCormack, Rhys Ifans). (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Lassie: A New Adventure
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Lassie teams up with Flo and new friends to solve the mysterious disappearance of pedigree dogs, using her sharp instincts to uncover the truth and save the missing pets. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Madison
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: 13-year-old Madison lives for cycle racing, striving to match her successful pro-cyclist dad. When she's forced to trade her road bike for a mountain bike, her talent is tested and chaos follows. (Action & Adventure)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Down With Love
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In 1962 New York City, love blossoms between a playboy journalist and a feminist advice author. (Similar)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Idol
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Teenage singer Mohammed Assaf travels from the Gaza Strip to Egypt to audition for the television show Arab Idol. (Movie, Biography, Drama, Music, Pop) - 2015

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Way Ahead
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A lieutenant moulds a group of British civilians into a crack fighting unit to meet Rommel's forces in North Africa. (Movie, War) - 1944

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Time Bandits
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A young boy is snatched from his suffocating suburban existence for a series of bizarre adventures in time and space by a band of renegade dwarfs. (Movie, Fantasy) - 1981

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Music and Lyrics
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A pop diva asks a washed-up '80s musician to write a hit song for her, so he recruits a lyrically-gifted plant caretaker to help him. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2007

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Daddio
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A woman gets into a taxi at New York's JFK International Airport and gradually tells the driver about her unfortunate decisions that led to an affair with a married man. The driver also reveals more and more about his life. (Movie, Drama) - 2023

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Sanctuary
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In the wake of inheriting his father's hotel chain, Hal tries to end his long and secret relationship with Rebecca, a dominatrix. A battle of wills ensues over the course of one fraught night, with Rebecca and Hal struggling to keep the upper hand. (Movie, Dark comedy) - 2022

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef - Old Favourites
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Maggie and Simon bring back some Old Favourites and, of course, reveal secrets that take your cooking to another level. Inspired by tradition and a gift of a pot from his Mum. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: There are some great recipes shared on today's episode including; Roast Duck, Peanut & Glass Noodle Salad, Cucumber and Mint Gazpacho with Sour Cream, and Mango and Passionfruit Cheesecakes. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Outback Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Justine prepares a dish at Little Miss Korea, takes a plunge in the Crocasauras Cove and checks out Darwin's nightlife at The Trader Bar with a Green Ant Cocktail. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Girl's Guide to Hunting, Fishing and Wild Cooking - New & Old Friends
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Analiese faces her biggest challenge yet, slaughtering the two pigs she's reared for meat, and is visited by old friends from the mainland who reaffirm her commitment to her new life. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: High Country Farm - Risky Cropping
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Nadia and Carlos tackle the crop that Royalburn is most famous for barley, but they branch out with a bold experiment to grow 5 million sunflowers on the upper paddocks of the Crown Terrace. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie's Comfort Food - The Ultimate Burger
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Jamie shares his recipes for three classic comfort foods. Plus, his friend Christian pops by to reveal the secret to his ultimate burger recipe. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - The Great Australian Pub Meal
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Chef Jacqui Challinor and actor Dave Lawson join Adam to make great Australian pub meals at home. And they won't even charge you extra for sauce. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Seafood
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops, demonstrating how to properly handle and prepare some of the ocean's most prized ingredients. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy - Casserole With It
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Nothing says comfort food like casserole, and Mary's got a variation for any time of the day, even breakfast and dessert! (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Prepare The Harvest
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Harvest time starts in late August in Italy, and it is one of the most important celebrations in the culture! Lidia celebrates with her oat risotto, makes olive-oil cake and red wine poached pears. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices - Cheeses Of Quebec
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: The Canadian province of Quebec is undergoing a cheese-making revival. Will visits Quebec to find out whether the original French settlers have had any influence on this renaissance. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Legends Of The Fork - Small Spaces Big Flavor
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Buddy heads to two small restaurants with huge reputations for making delicious food. First up is DiFara Pizza in Brooklyn, New York to learn the secrets to their famous slice. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera - Finale Ligure
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Luana cooks on one of the town's most beautiful beaches, harvests basil beneath the waves, meets Anna, an artist inspired by the surrounding landscapes and discovers one of the region’s finest honeys. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery - Tornedalen, Sweden
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: There are not many places in Sweden like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen - Chilli Crab With Tamarind, Chicken Vermicelli Mushroom, Marinated Pearl Shell Meat Salad
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Kriol Kitchen hosts with Adam Liaw. Adam is a cook, writer and presenter of The Cook Up With Adam Liaw. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef - Old Favourites
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Maggie and Simon bring back some Old Favourites and, of course, reveal secrets that take your cooking to another level. Inspired by tradition and a gift of a pot from his Mum. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Laura is in the beautiful Adelaide Hills, creating a winter warmer: Mushroom Pies. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes - Pesto Pasta & Chicken Cutlet
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Rachael brings the flavour with her Lemon Lover's Chicken Cutlets and Pesto Pasta. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Wendy joins Laura as they make a Swedish potato pudding; Tobie makes tiramisu; Catherine cooks spring onion in the form of a chip; Simone prepares delicious rice paper rolls. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home - Beans
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: The beautiful British summer-time sees Jamie getting a thorough soaking as he picks the beans in his garden. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: There are some great recipes shared on today's episode including; Roast Duck, Peanut & Glass Noodle Salad, Cucumber and Mint Gazpacho with Sour Cream, and Mango and Passionfruit Cheesecakes. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - The Great Australian Pub Meal
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Chef Jacqui Challinor and actor Dave Lawson join Adam to make great Australian pub meals at home. And they won't even charge you extra for sauce. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy - Soup's On!
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Mary. Loves. Soup. Join the soup obsession with recipes that vary from cozy to chill, smooth or chunky, plus an ample dose of cheese, duh. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Salt Your Pasta Water!
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: It's pasta time again, so don't forget to salt the pasta water, and sauce your pasta the way the Italians do! Lidia prepares a pasta primavera, then a cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices - The Ancient Cheese Of Portugal
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Until recently, Portugal's traditional ewe's milk cheeses were rarely found outside the country. Will travels to the rugged mountains of the north to find out more about the king of Portuguese cheese. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Legends Of The Fork - Bringing The Heat
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: We're turning up the heat! Buddy visits two iconic hotspots who are famous for their intensely spicy dishes. First, he heads to Jitlada in Los Angeles, California to see if he can withstand the heat. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera - Monte Carlo Noel
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Luana takes us behind the scenes of the Principality's most iconic landmarks, including Casino Square, the Cafe de Paris, and the kitchens of the Hotel Hermitage Monte-Carlo. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery - Nordjylland, Denmark
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen - Lemon Grass And Soya Turtle, Shellfish Stir-Fry Noodle, Susami
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Bundy runs his own Cultural Tours business out of Chile Creek near the communities of Djarindjin and Lombadina. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef - Winter Comfort Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: It's time to shake off the winter blues with a serve of piping hot comfort food. This mid-winter episode dishes up some warming, homely treats - and reveals why Simon still bears the mental scars. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Laura visits the wonderful Adelaide Central Markets and cooks up an Asian-inspired Kingfish Sashimi with Nahm Jim. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes - Bacon Jack Burger
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Rachael shares her secrets for the ultimate Bacon Jack Burger, from scoring the meat for perfect portions to packing equal amounts of crispy bacon into every bite. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: This episode celebrates saffron, one of the world's most prized ingredients. Luca begins with a golden, fragrant risotto, follows with a refined pasta dish that lets saffron truly shine. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Holidays - Vegetarian Feast
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Rachael shows how to prepare a show-stopping, meat-free holiday meal that everyone will love! First, she makes a rich and flavourful pumpkin soup using Italian pumpkins. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Things get dicey after Laura is inspired by in-season passionfruit at the market and decides to make a passionfruit sponge cake. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home - Onions
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Jamie pulls up some of his first onions of the year and makes a crisp and fresh cheese and onion salad. The red onions he uses in an onion and potato al forno with tender roast pork. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Hong Kong Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Justine shows you around Macao on today's episode and shows off her Chicken and Asian Mushroom Fricassee Stew with a view! (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - The Italian Table
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Chef Giovanni Pilu and author Julia Busuttil Nishimura join Adam for a night of Easy Entertaining at The Italian Table. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella's Cook, Eat, Repeat Christmas - Nigella's Cook, Eat, Repeat Christmas Special
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: The Christmas tree is up, the tea lights are sparkling, wood burns in the fire pit and it's the culinary hi-light of the festive season and this year Nigella is indulging in kitchen table tourism. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Berry's Ultimate Christmas
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Much loved British home cook Mary Berry is joined by some famous friends for her ultimate Christmas feast, packed with tips to plan and get ahead for the big day. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Jamie is joined by his friend Gennaro to make a delicious bolognese ravioli. Plus, Jamie puts together the ultimate cheese toast, and cooks a chicken tikka masala. (Special Interest)

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Do Not Watch This Show

ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E2 Something New Still suffering emotionally from his beating, Mark misdiagnoses cases. Carter deals with the loss of his seniority and meets his incompetent new medical student, George. Kenny Law's family sues for medical malpractice.

ABCMESydney.au.title: triple j Like A Version
ABCMESydney.au.description: E49 triple j's legendary Like A Version segment hosts the greatest local and international acts, performing a cover of a song they love, and one of their own.

ABCMESydney.au.title: rage Charts
ABCMESydney.au.description: E324 Episode 324 Australia's longest running music TV show, rage is home to the biggest vault of music videos from a diverse range of artists, genres and eras. We curate the best clips of all time to surprise and entertain you for hours.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Pianist
ABCMESydney.au.description: During WWII, pianist and composer Wladyslaw Szpilman becomes separated from his family. As the situation worsens, he must hide in the ruins of Warsaw and put his trust in a sympathetic German officer in order to survive.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S11 E11 Jumpers QI gets the joint jumping. Join QI master Stephen Fry with guest panellists Julian Clary, Ross Noble, Bill Bailey and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E16 A Sticky Situation Kai faces his fears when spiders get loose in the temple.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E33 Exit Sandman Mavis and the gang are rebuilding Diane's chicken coop, but the noise from it is preventing the Sandman from getting any sleep. So in order to get some shut eye, he puts the entire hotel under a spell.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E34 Roadkill Trip The Roadkill Grill is closing for good and Mavis suggests that she and Uncle Gene go on one last road trip together. But getting there before they close is proving to be way harder than either of them imagined.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The InBESTigators
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E22 The Case Of The Soccer Saga Kyle asks Maudie and Ava to make a video of his soccer match but Maudie discovers something about the game is not quite right.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E26 In the Garden of Good and Eddie The Girls deal with a giant, mooching worm.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E21 Donny In an attempt to save a village, Finn and Jake rehabilitate Donny the Ogre, who's a real jerk.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E23 Citizen Tabes After accidentally wounding an animal, Ranger Tabes quits her job.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E35 Operation Dude Rescue: Part One The guys are captured and the girls go rescue them.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E23 Kuro Neko If Cat Noir decided to quit and give his Miraculous back to Ladybug, who could possibly replace him?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Moominvalley
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E7 Thingumy & Bob In his desire for more independence, Moomintroll pushes Moominmamma away. But he soon becomes jealous when she finds a new outlet for her motherly love.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mechamato
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E6 Welcome to Robojaya Amato and Pian plan to go into the Mechanizer to see the new town the Cone Konchos have built, but things go wrong when Bula and Bili accidentally join them.

ABCMESydney.au.title: 100% Wolf: Legend of the Moonstone
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E3 The Golden Horn Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human while searching for a cure for her new human form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious 'Golden Horn' and prove who the alpha wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E5 Worst In Show After a Giant Houndbeast attacks an elite dog show, the gang goes undercover and enters Scooby in the show in order to solve the mystery.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E3 Nightcap Barb and the elves band together to protect the source of all magic from a pair of fiendish intruders. But will Barb be able to outsmart two rascals as old as the world itself?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Drama Island: Reboot
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E2 Pirates of the Cabbagean Our two teams go to war, firing cabbages from cannons at each other from their respective pirate ships. The first team to sink the other will be the winner, but someone takes a very personal interest in one specific target.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E18 Casket If You Can Mavis is tasked with guarding a sleeping Aunt Lydia in her rejuvenation casket. But naturally she loses the casket and it goes on a long adventure around town. Now Mavis needs to track it down and find it!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E38 First Contact - Pt: 2 It's Jim's first day as captain, and the submarine is already hijacked by a mysterious sea creature. Thrown into his first high-stakes negotiation, does Jim have what it takes to lead?

ABCMESydney.au.title: The InBESTigators
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E22 The Case Of The Soccer Saga Kyle asks Maudie and Ava to make a video of his soccer match but Maudie discovers something about the game is not quite right.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Badjelly
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 Mouse Trap The gang are captured by Dinglemouse, a swashbuckling rodent who used to be a banana.

ABCMESydney.au.title: GG: Spawn Squad
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E30 Getting Home in Little Kitty Big City! Mila and Harry cause a little trouble in a big city as they attempt to get their kitty home! Along the way they help some ducklings, steal some fish and collect some quirky cat hats.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Unikitty
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E39 Trapped in the Tower During a fireworks show, Unikitty and Master Frown become trapped in the Unikitty Castle. She sees an opportunity to figure out why Master Frown is always such a Cranky McCrabby Face all the time.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Unikitty
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E40 Scary Tales 2 During the gang's Halloween party, Unikitty discovers Rick isn't scared of anything! They each tell their own ideas of what a spooky story is, hoping to scare the emotionless Rick for once.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E14 Moon Problems The Moon gets sad when Oscar loses his friendship bracelet.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E15 Monster Visit The monsters get nervous when their Godmonster comes for a visit.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E10 Go With Me Finn needs a date to the movies and must balance the contrasting advice of Jake and Marceline in wooing Princess Bubblegum so he can see that flick!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokémon Horizons: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E42 A Surprise Reunion The Rising Volt Tacklers are surprised by the arrival of some unexpected guests.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokémon Horizons: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E43 Lucario's Challenge! Roy and Lucario take on Master Mayonnaise and Mega Hawlucha in a rematch battle.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E1 Sky Cabin and a Viking Longhouse George has the ludicrous idea to turn a rusty scissor lift into a cabin in the sky! Four shipping containers become a one-off accommodation, and a trailer is turned into a pretty in pink beauty parlour.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E2 Painting It's been over a year since Frank's passing and unfortunately for Lee and Lucy, Wendy rediscovers her love of painting and gifts them a portrait of Frank. How can Lee and Lucy break the news that they don't like the likeness?

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
ABCMESydney.au.description: In late 1950s New York, Tom Ripley, a young underachiever, is sent to Italy to retrieve Dickie Greenleaf, a rich and spoiled millionaire playboy. But when the errand fails, Ripley takes extreme measures.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E2 Something New Still suffering emotionally from his beating, Mark misdiagnoses cases. Carter deals with the loss of his seniority and meets his incompetent new medical student, George. Kenny Law's family sues for medical malpractice.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E10 Cleve Crudgington Joining Stephen Fry are Alan Davies, Mark Steel, Clive Anderson and John Sessions. The series continues with the 'C' theme.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S14 E12 The Best Bits Rob Brydon, Lee Mack and David Mitchell return in an episode packed with some of the best bits from the series. Guests include Richard Osman, Claudia Winkleman, Samantha Morton and AJ Odudu. (Final).

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E5 Episode 5 It’s cops and swabbers as Adam and Jamie turn dirt detectives to get to the bottom of two frighteningly filthy myths, while Tory, Grant and Jessi skip the lake fantastic with a manic movie myth.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E18 Bristol Phil heads to the village of Hanham just near Bristol, where he meets owners who are eager to sell properties that include a three bedroom family home and a deceptively spacious terraced house.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E2 Seashell Bar and a Train Carriage A train carriage and a Luton Van get turned into accommodation, George Clarke visits an underground bar and a Danish house covered in seashells.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E25 Kasey Chambers, Brian Mannix, Claire Hooper & Rusty Berther The Spicks and Specks team are joined by one of Australia's favourite country singers Kasey Chambers, Uncanny X-Men front-man, rocker Brian Mannix and comedians Rusty Berther and Claire Hooper.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S21 E2 \ Sandi Toksvig takes a look at animals that begin with the letter 'T' with Hannah Waddingham, Desiree Burch, Jason Manford, and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E1 Sanjeev Bhaskar, Fern Britton, Martin Clunes & Richard E. Grant Rob Brydon and team captains David Mitchell and Lee Mack are joined by Sanjeev Bhaskar, Fern Britton, Martin Clunes and Richard E. Grant.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Guy Montgomery's Guy Mont Spelling Bee (NZ)
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E8 Episode 8 Jackie van Beek, Jesse Griffin, Hoani Hotene and the Episode Seven champ battle to the spelling death in Spelling Carnival, Spell It Backwards and Spell the Audience Name.

ABCMESydney.au.title: triple j Live at the Wireless
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E3 Courtney Barnett triple j's legendary live music series, Live At The Wireless, is back with iconic performances. Iconic Australian singer-songwriter Courtney Barnett graces the stage, recorded live at the triple j 50 Tour in Hobart, Tasmania.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Upstart Crow
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 What Bloody Man Is That? The plague leads Will and his friends to escape to the family home in Stratford. On the way, they meet three witches who have some surprising predictions about Will's future, leading to a very serious case of house envy.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Upstart Crow
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 The Quality Of Mercy There's money to be made investing in cargos from the New World: but while Marlowe invests in tobacco and potato products, Will would rather invest in building a new theatre. (Final).

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E5 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 1 UNIT are summoned to Wenley Moor research station which is experiencing mysterious power losses. In the nearby caves, one of the staff has been killed and another sent insane.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E6 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 2 Investigating the caves, the Doctor is attacked by a dinosaur-like creature. Dr Quinn is hiding a secret that could endanger the lives of everyone.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E7 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 3 The creature from the caves, wounded and dangerous, is on the loose on Wenley Moor. Dr Quinn attempts to recover it and is unwilling to listen to the Doctor’s warnings.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E8 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 4 Fearful of a war breaking out between the Silurians and mankind, the Doctor attempts to make peace between the races. But there are those on both sides unwilling to listen.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E9 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 5 When the Silurian leader is killed, all hopes of peace are lost. The Silurian’s infect Major Baker with a virus deadly to humans and release him to spread the infection.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E10 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 6 As the Silurian plague quickly spreads, the Doctor desperately searches for a cure. But the Silurians are aware of the Doctor’s efforts and intend to stop him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E11 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 7 With the antidote to the plague found, the Silurians retaliate and take over the research centre. They now intend to destroy the Van Allen Belt, resulting in death for all mankind.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E12 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 1 Contact has been lost with Mars Probe 7. When contact is also lost with the recovery ship, UNIT is called in and the Doctor learns that someone is sending messages to the vessel.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E13 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 2 Recovery 7 has returned to Earth but the UNIT convoy transporting the capsule is ambushed. The Doctor is able to relocate the capsule, but is he too late?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E14 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 3 The recovery capsule is empty with the astronauts seemingly kidnapped. But Liz notices that the radiation count is high and the Doctor deduces that the occupants were not human.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E15 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 4 Liz has been captured by Reegan who is holding the three aliens captive. The Doctor suspects Quinlan’s part in the conspiracy, but Quinlan is killed before he can reveal the truth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E12 Survival: Part 1 Trying to work out why people have been disappearing from Perivale, Ace is cornered by a Cheetah-Person on a horse called Kara, who transports her to a far-off planet.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E13 Survival: Part 2 The Doctor and a number of people from Perivale follow Ace to the Cheetah-People’s world, where the Master lies in wait. He cannot leave without the Doctor's assistance.

BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E16 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 5 The Doctor prepares to pilot the Recovery 7 ship into space, but Reegan sabotages the fuel supply which will send the Doctor into the sun.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E17 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 6 On board a vast spacecraft, the Doctor meets the alien captain who demands the return of the three ambassadors sent to Earth or he will destroy the world.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E18 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 7 General Carrington is behind the kidnapping of the ambassadors and intends to turn the world against the aliens by revealing their true identity to the world in a TV broadcast.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E19 Inferno: Episode 1 UNIT are at a project run by Professor Stahlman who intends to penetrate Earth’s crust. But the drilling has already released something deadly from beneath the Earth’s surface.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E20 Inferno: Episode 2 The green slime oozing from the drill head is transforming men into monsters. Stahlman refuses to listen to the warnings and resorts to sabotage so that his project may continue.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E21 Inferno: Episode 3 Transported to a parallel world, the Doctor discovers that England is under military rule and the drilling project is at a more advanced stage.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E22 Inferno: Episode 4 In the parallel world, the drilling project is about to penetrate the Earth’s crust. The Doctor, arrested as a spy, is unable to convince his captors of the danger that faces them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E23 Inferno: Episode 5 In the parallel world, Earth’s crust has been penetrated, releasing terrible forces from within the Earth. The Doctor must escape back to his world to prevent the same catastrophe.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E24 Inferno: Episode 6 As the Earth in the parallel world faces destruction, the Doctor is desperate to return to his world to warn them of the danger. But time is running out.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E25 Inferno: Episode 7 The Doctor has escaped the doomed, parallel Earth and has returned to his own world where he attempts to put a halt to the drilling project.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E1 Terror of the Autons: Episode 1 The Master, a renegade Time Lord and a rival of the Doctor’s, arrives on Earth and paves the way for an invasion by the insidious Nestene Consciousness.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E2 Terror of the Autons: Episode 2 The Doctor follows the Master’s trail to the circus. Meanwhile, the Master has used his hypnotic powers to take control of a plastics factory where he creates the deadly Autons.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E3 Terror of the Autons: Episode 3 The Doctor and the Brigadier trace the Master to the plastics factory but they are too late. The only clue to the Master’s plans is a single plastic daffodil.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E4 Terror of the Autons: Episode 4 The Doctor and UNIT race to prevent the Master from broadcasting the deadly activation signal and opening the channel for the Nestene’s arrival on Earth.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E36 The Prussian Blue Mystery When a San Diego woman who is near death arrives at an emergency room, the FBI and local law enforcement are called in to try to solve a medical mystery and a horrific crime.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped: Killer Moms
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E03 Kelly Turner When a Colorado mother claims her daughter is mysteriously ill, doctors question if they have a Munchausen by proxy case; the investigation reveals the horrific truth behind the lengths a mother is willing to go with her child's life for attention.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped: Killer Moms
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E05 Kristen Dean Jennings After a Texas man goes missing, the investigation leads detectives to the estranged mother of his children; in an exclusive prison interview, Kristen Dean reveals the desperate lengths she went to for her daughter and the sinister plot behind it.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Turpin 13: Family Secrets Exposed
oxygenwest.us.description: Delving into the story surrounding the Turpin family and the parents, David and Louise, who have been charged with keeping their children shackled and starved within the four walls of their own Perris, Calif., home.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E03 The Tourniquet Killer When DNA breaks open a decades-old cold case, Kelly Siegler finds herself prosecuting one of the most intelligent killers she has ever faced. What begins with one victim exposes the crimes of a monstrous serial killer who escaped justice for years.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler

The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

Kimmel's family and friends take part in the festivities, including his Cousin Sal, Uncle Frank (until his death in 2011) and childhood friend Cleto Escobedo III, who leads the show's house band. Recurring segments include the FCC-pleasing This Week in Unnecessary Censorship in which they take TV clips and "bleep and blur things whether they need it or not," as Kimmel describes it. fxm.us.title: Berlin Correspondent
fxm.us.description: In 1941 Berlin, the Gestapo's efforts to uncover the source of vital information broadcast by American correspondent Bill Roberts remain elusive. The Gestapo colonel in charge of the investigation presses his fiancée, Karen Hauen, to help and, with reluctance, she agrees. After befriending Bill, Karen discovers how he receives the information, but when she also learns who provides it, she is exposed for the first time to the brutal tactics of her government. (Thriller) - 1942

fxm.us.title: Where the Sidewalk Ends
fxm.us.description: Ashamed that his father lived a life of crime, hard-boiled New York City cop Mark Dixon has a reputation for being too tough on criminals. So when Dixon unintentionally kills a murder suspect during a routine questioning, he hides the fact from the department and tries to pin the killing on his nemesis, notorious gangster Scalise. The snag in the cop's plan comes when his boss wrongly accuses the father of Dixon's love interest, Morgan, of the murder. (Crime drama) - 1950

fxm.us.title: Black Widow
fxm.us.description: At a party, Broadway producer Peter Denver (Van Heflin) meets Nancy Ordway (Peggy Ann Garner), a young writer struggling to make it in New York City. Taking pity on her, Denver offers Nancy his apartment as a place to write while his wife, Iris (Gene Tierney), is away. Shortly after, Nancy is found dead in his bathroom, apparently murdered, and Denver is, of course, the main suspect. As rumors swirl about his involvement with Nancy, Denver decides to search for her killer himself. (Mystery) - 1954

fxm.us.title: The Neptune Factor
fxm.us.description: When an earthquake on the ocean floor causes an underwater laboratory to fall into a deep trench and places the scientists' lives in peril, Cmdr. Adrian Blake (Ben Gazzara) embarks on a rescue mission in his small experimental submarine. Along with a crew that includes Dr. Leah Jansen (Yvette Mimieux) and diver Don MacKay (Ernest Borgnine), Blake attempts to save the scientists from the unexplored depths, while encountering gigantic sea creatures that threaten their survival. (Science fiction) - 1973

fxm.us.title: Eyewitness
fxm.us.description: New York City custodian Daryll Deever (William Hurt) is a big fan of local news reporter Tony Sokolow (Sigourney Weaver), so he is intrigued when she shows up to cover a story at his workplace. There's been a murder in the office building, and Tony suspects that Daryll may have insight into the crime, a notion that he furthers to stay close to her. However, when those behind the killing begin to think that Daryll really knows something, they target both him and Tony to keep their secrets hidden. (Thriller) - 1981

fxm.us.title: The Aftermath
fxm.us.description: In 1946 Rachael Morgan arrives in the ruins of Hamburg to be reunited with her husband, Lewis, who is a British colonel charged with rebuilding the shattered city. As they set off for their new home, Rachael is stunned to discover that Lewis has made an unexpected decision: They will be sharing the grand house with its previous owners, a German widower and his troubled daughter. In this charged atmosphere, enmity and grief give way to passion and betrayal. (Historical drama, Romance) - 2019

fxm.us.title: The Last Duel
fxm.us.description: Jean de Carrouges is a respected knight known for his bravery and skill on the battlefield. Jacques Le Gris is a squire whose intelligence and eloquence makes him one of the most admired nobles in court. When Le Gris viciously assaults Carrouges' wife, she steps forward to accuse her attacker, an act of bravery and defiance that puts her life in jeopardy. The ensuing trial by combat, a grueling duel to the death, places the fate of all three in God's hands. (Historical drama) - 2021

fxm.us.title: The Banshees of Inisherin
fxm.us.description: On a remote island off the coast of Ireland, Pádraic is devastated when his buddy Colm suddenly puts an end to their lifelong friendship. With help from his sister and a troubled young islander, Pádraic sets out to repair the damaged relationship by any means necessary. However, as Colm's resolve only strengthens, he soon delivers an ultimatum that leads to shocking consequences. (Dark comedy) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Freud's Last Session
fxm.us.description: On the eve of World War II, Sigmund Freud and C.S. Lewis gather to discuss the existence of God and the future of mankind. (Drama) - 2023

fxm.us.title: Dirty Mary, Crazy Larry
fxm.us.description: Down on their luck and out of cash, high-speed racer Larry (Peter Fonda) and his repairman (Adam Roarke) plan to hold up a supermarket that's fat with a fresh payroll. Larry hopes to score enough to buy his ideal car, and then join the professional league. At the last minute, their heist is complicated by the addition of Larry's on-off girlfriend (Susan George), who's all jazzed up for the burglary. Larry's racing skills will be pushed to the limit in this chase-packed action thriller. (Action) - 1974

fxm.us.title: Surf Party
fxm.us.description: An Arizona gal (Patricia Morrow) and her friends enjoy sun, sand and romance when they drive out to California for a surfing vacation. (Musical comedy, Romance) - 1964

fxm.us.title: How to Marry a Millionaire
fxm.us.description: Schatze Page, Loco Dempsey and Pola Debevoise (Lauren Bacall, Betty Grable, Marilyn Monroe) are three women on a mission: They all want to marry a millionaire. To accomplish this task, they move into a fancy New York City apartment and begin courting the city's elite. They have no problem meeting rich men, but unfortunately most of them turn out to be creeps or cons. Eventually they must decide: Is a life of luxury more important to them than finding true love? (Comedy) - 1953

fxm.us.title: The Seven Year Itch
fxm.us.description: In the midst of a summer heat wave, New Yorker Richard Sherman (Tom Ewell) ships his wife, Helen (Evelyn Keyes), and their son off to Maine for vacation. Left alone to work back in Manhattan, Richard encounters a gorgeous blonde model (Marilyn Monroe) who has moved into the apartment upstairs, and becomes immediately infatuated. While pondering infidelity, Richard dreams of his beautiful new neighbor -- but will his fantasies about her become a reality? (Comedy) - 1955
